summary: YieldGenerator is a web app helping farmers compare crop plans using NASA Earth data. Farmers enter their location, crops, acreage, growing months, and irrigation method. The app combines NASA POWER weather and soil wetness with USDA yields and prices, UC Davis cost studies, and energy data. It estimates harvest, water use, expenses, and operating margin across historical seasons. Its optimization feature identifies plans within land, water, and budget limits.
details: YieldGenerator helps farmers compare crop plans within land, water, and budget limits. Farmers enter location, crops, acreage, growing months, and irrigation methods. NASA POWER weather and soil wetness drive modeled water needs and crop responses. USDA yields and prices support harvest and revenue estimates, while agricultural studies and energy data inform expenses. Built with React, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, and SciPy, the app backtests historical seasons and optimizes crop choices. Interactive charts, formulas, and source links explain results. Our team considered usability, irrigation efficiency, growing calendars, regional costs, and transparent calculations to support informed farm planning under changing conditions and constraints.
